== Notes ==
* This skill can ''not'' "steal" [[Monster skill|monster]]-only enchantments (e.g. [[Demonic Agility]]); however, the energy gain does happen and Revealed Enchantment recharges instantly.
* It is possible to steal enchantments you need to [[Upkeep|maintain]], such as [[Mending]]. They will remain active when Revealed Enchantment ends.
* Heroes will use the copied skill as they normally would do.
** Maintained enchantments that heroes would dismiss can be disabled to be maintained for the duration of the copy effect. When the copy effect ends the enchantment will be dropped as soon as the AI dictates it to (i.e. the hero is not in a situation where it would normally maintain the enchantment). Out of combat, [[Blessed Aura]], [[Divine Boon]] and [[Unyielding Aura]] are the only maintained enchantments that the AI won't immediately dismiss.
